Certificate to Proceed

A complete, screenshot-by-screenshot walkthrough of the Certificate to Proceed (CP) process in the NYC HPD PIMS system — from creating the CP module (manually or auto-created from Article XI), through the Program PM package, the Capital Budget Team review and analyst assignment, the Capital Planning Analyst’s budget and certification work, and the Program PM’s amendment decision, to completion.

This guide follows one Certificate to Proceed package end to end — including the amendment path — so you can see what each screen does and what to expect next.

Tip: click any screenshot to enlarge it for a closer look.

About This Guide

A Certificate to Proceed confirms that a project’s budget and funding are authorized so the project can move forward. In PIMS it is handled as a module on the project, reviewed by HPD’s Capital Budget team and a Capital Planning Analyst, and submitted to OMB for the certificate.

  • A CP module can be created two ways: manually from the project via Initiate Process → Certificate to Proceed, or automatically when an Article XI module completes with “Is Certificate to Proceed required? = Yes.”
  • The module is worked by the Program PM, the Capital Budget Team (CP Management Team), and a Capital Planning Analyst, and supports an Amendment when the budget changes.

Login is not covered here. Each part begins from the screen you see immediately after signing in as the relevant role.

Purpose of This Guide

A hands-on training reference. Each step pairs an actual screenshot with a clear Action (what to do) and Result (what to expect), with references to the Certificate to Proceed Visio future-state flow for traceability.

Who Should Use This Guide

  • HPD Program — the Program PM (module owner) who compiles and submits the CP package and decides on amendments.
  • HPD Budget / Capital Budget Team — the CP Management Team that reviews the documents and assigns the Capital Planning Analyst, and the Capital Planning Analyst who adds the budget details and certification page.
  • OMB — the Office of Management and Budget, which reviews the submission and issues the date-stamped certificate.

Before You Begin

  • A valid PIMS account with the appropriate role (Program, Capital Budget / CP Management Team, or Capital Planning Analyst).
  • A project that needs a Certificate to Proceed — either create the CP module from the project, or have a completed Article XI module with ‘CP required = Yes.’
  • The CP Package components ready — Narrative Questionnaire, Underwriting Workbook, Budget Code Questionnaire, and any additional supporting documentation — plus the Certification Page and Budget Details.
  • A supported web browser (latest Google Chrome recommended).

Process at a Glance

  • 1A CP module is created — manually from the project (Initiate Process) or automatically when an Article XI module completes with ‘CP required = Yes’
  • 2Program PM compiles the CP Package (Narrative Questionnaire, Underwriting Workbook, Budget Code Questionnaire) and submits it for approval
  • 3Capital Budget Team (CP Management Team) reviews & verifies the documents, then assigns a Capital Planning Analyst
  • 4Capital Planning Analyst reviews, adds Budget Details, uploads the Certification Page, updates the CP Package Submission Details, and submits to OMB
  • 5Program PM reviews the budget and decides whether an amendment is required
  • 6If required, a CP Amendment is created and worked through the same review & sign-off chain
  • 7The original CP and its amendment are Completed on the project’s Modules list

Part A — Creating the Certificate to Proceed Module

Step 1: Log in to PIMS

Action Log in to the PIMS portal. You land on the Home dashboard, where Action Items, Active Modules, and Pending Milestones in My Queue show the work assigned to you.

Result You are signed in and can navigate to the project you want to work.

Process map reference: Visio — Start: a Certificate to Proceed (CP) package needs to be created for the project.

Step 2: Open the Projects Object

Action Click the app launcher / object drop-down at the top and select Projects.

Result The Projects object opens.

Step 3: Select the Project

Action From the Projects list, click the project you want to create the Certificate to Proceed for.

Result The project record opens.

Step 4: Open the Project and Initiate the Process

Action On the project record you can see all the project information across tabs (Programs, Buildings, Entities, Project Funding’s, Modules, and more). At the top-right, click Initiate Process. (This is the first of two ways to create a CP module — manually from the project.)

Result The Initiate Process dialog opens.

Step 5: Select Certificate to Proceed

Action In the Initiate Process dialog, under Which Process do you want to Initiate? select Certificate to Proceed, then click Next.

Result PIMS begins creating the Certificate to Proceed module.

Step 6: CP Module Created from the Project

Action A confirmation appears: “The Certificate to Proceed (CP) module has been successfully created. Please navigate to Module tab → CP Module.” Click Next.

Result The CP module now exists on the project. This completes the manual creation path.

Step 7: Way 1 — The CP Module on the Project

Action Navigate to the Modules tab and open the CP module. Here the record CP - Original - Grand Concourse Commons shows the CP details and guidance to success.

Result The manually created Certificate to Proceed module is ready to be worked.

Step 8: Way 2 — Auto-Created from Article XI

Action The second way is automatic. When an Article XI module is completed, if “Is Certificate to Proceed required?” was answered Yes during its approval, PIMS automatically creates the CP module. On the Atlantic Housing Partners LLC project’s Modules list, the Article XI module shows Completed and CP - Original - Atlantic Housing Partners LLC has been created automatically. The rest of this guide follows this Atlantic Housing Partners package.

Result The CP module is auto-created from the completed Article XI module.

Process map reference: Visio — CP required flag on Article XI drives auto-creation of the CP module.

Part B — Program PM: Compile & Submit the CP Package

Step 9: Open the CP Module

Action Click CP - Original - Atlantic Housing Partners LLC to open the module. As the Program PM (the module Owner), the guidance instructs you to upload the required documents under the Documents tab: Narrative Questionnaire, Underwriting Workbook, Budget Code Questionnaire, and any additional supporting documentation.

Result The CP module opens with the PM’s to-do list.

Process map reference: Visio Step 1 — HPD Program compiles the CP Package.

Step 10: Open the Documents Tab

Action Click the Documents tab. The Document Checklist shows each required document with a status of Pending.

Result The Document Checklist is ready for uploads.

Step 11: Upload the CP Package Documents

Action On a document line, click the upload icon. In the Upload Documents dialog, drag and drop or Choose Files, then click Upload. Repeat for each required document.

Result Each file is attached to its checklist item.

Step 12: Documents Submitted

Action Once all required documents are uploaded, the Document Checklist shows each as Submitted. At the top-right, click Submit for Approval.

Result The CP package is ready to be routed for review.

Step 13: Add Comments and Submit

Action In the Submit for Approval dialog, add comments (for example, “All the required documents are uploaded, please review and approve”) and click Submit.

Result The CP package is routed to the Capital Budget Team.

Process map reference: Visio Step 2 — Program submits the CP package to the Capital Budget Team via PIMS.

Step 14: Approval Work Item — Capital Budget Team

Action Click the Approval Work Item tab to track the approval flow. The work item (AWI-…) is Assigned to the CP Management Team under the CP Analyst Assignment approval chain.

Result The package is now with the Capital Budget Team for review.

Part C — Capital Budget Team: Review & Assign the Analyst

Step 15: Log in as the CP Management Team

Action Log in as a member of the CP Management Team. On the Home page, under Action Items, the Atlantic Housing Partners LLC project is Assigned to the CP Management Team — click View.

Result The assigned CP review opens.

Process map reference: Visio Step 3 — Capital Budget Team review.

Step 16: Review the Module — CP Analyst Assignment Stage

Action The module opens at the CP Analyst Assignment stage. On the Details tab you can see all the module information; the Action Item on the right asks you to review the uploaded documents and select the appropriate Capital Planning Analyst.

Result You can now review the documents before assigning an analyst.

Step 17: Open and Review a Document

Action Go to the Documents tab and click the eye icon on a document line. The All Uploaded Files viewer opens with three options — Request Info, Reject Document, or Verify.

Result The uploaded file opens for review.

Process map reference: Visio Step 4 — Are there any questions on the package?.

Step 18: Verify the Document

Action Following the standard path, click Verify. In the Comments dialog, add a comment (for example, “Approved”) and click Submit. Repeat for each document.

Result Each document is marked Verified.

Step 19: Assign the Capital Planning Analyst

Action Back on the module, the CP Analyst Assignment Action Item asks you to select the appropriate user in the Capital Planning Analyst field.

Result The analyst-assignment step is ready.

Process map reference: Visio Step 5 — Capital Budget Team assigns the CP to a Capital Planning Analyst.

Step 20: Select the Analyst and Submit

Action With the documents Verified, select the appropriate Capital Planning Analyst from the drop-down and click Submit.

Result The Capital Planning Analyst is assigned to the CP.

Step 21: Capital Planning Analyst Assigned

Action On the module Details, the Capital Planning Analyst field now shows the assigned user (for example, Partha Mareddy).

Result The CP is now routed to the assigned Capital Planning Analyst.

Part D — Capital Planning Analyst: Budget, Certification & Submission

Step 22: Log in as the Capital Planning Analyst

Action Log in as the assigned Capital Planning Analyst. On the Home page, under Action Items, the Atlantic Housing Partners LLC project is assigned to you — click View.

Result The assigned CP review opens for the Capital Planning Analyst.

Process map reference: Visio Step 6 — Capital Planning Analyst works the CP toward OMB submission.

Step 23: Confirm the Document Review

Action The module opens at the CP Analyst Review stage. On the right, the Action Item asks: “Have you reviewed all the necessary documents?” Select Yes.

Result The first review question is answered.

Step 24: Answer the Follow-Up Question

Action A second question appears: “Do you have any questions or require any updates to the submitted documents?”

Result The analyst confirms whether the package is complete.

Step 25: Add Comments and Submit

Action Following the standard path, select No, add comments (for example, “Everything looks good”), and click Submit.

Result The review is recorded and the CP moves to the CP Analyst Sign Off stage.

Step 26: Add the Budget Details

Action At the CP Analyst Sign Off stage the guidance asks the analyst to add the Budget Details, upload the Certification Page, and update the CP Package Submission Details. In the Budget Details section, click New.

Result The New Budget Details form opens.

Process map reference: Visio — budget codes created/authorized for the project.

Step 27: Complete and Save the Budget Details

Action In the New Budget Details form, fill in the budget fields — Funding Source, Budget Code, Grant Year, Budget Line, Object Code, Agency Code, Amount, Cost Limitation, etc. — then click Save.

Result The budget details are saved.

Step 28: Budget Details Record Created

Action A Budget Details record (BD-…) is created and linked to the CP module, showing the funding source, budget code, grant year, and amount.

Result The budget record is on the module.

Step 29: Upload the Certification Page

Action Return to the module and open the Documents tab. A new Certification Page document line shows as Pending — click the upload icon and upload the Certification Page.

Result The Certification Page is attached to the module.

Process map reference: Visio — OMB issues the date-stamped Certificate / Certification Page.

Step 30: Update the CP Package Submission Details

Action The Certification Page now shows Submitted. Under CP Package Submission Details, fill in the fields — Date Submitted to Capital Planning, Internal Status (e.g., OMB Review), and CP Package Submission Date to OMB — then click Save.

Result The submission details are recorded (the package is submitted to OMB for review).

Process map reference: Visio Step 6 — Capital Planning Analyst submits the package to OMB via ROSE.

Step 31: Confirm the Budget Details

Action On the right, the CP Analyst Sign Off Action Item asks: “Can you please confirm whether the budget details have been added to the Budget Details section?” Select Yes and click Submit.

Result The budget details are confirmed.

Step 32: Submit the Budget Details for Approval

Action With the budget details submitted, the guidance says: “Once all the Budget Details records are submitted, please click Submit for Approval.” At the top-right, click Submit for Approval.

Result The Submit for Approval dialog opens.

Step 33: Add Comments and Submit

Action Add comments and click Submit.

Result The CP budget package is routed to the Program PM for review.

Part E — Program PM Review, Amendment & Completion

Step 34: Log in as the Program PM — Budget Details Review

Action Log in as the Program PM. The module opens at the Budget Details Review stage: “As a PM, please review all the Budget Details records under the Budget Details section.” Review the budget uploaded by the Capital Planning Analyst.

Result The PM reviews the budget and decides whether an amendment is needed.

Process map reference: Visio — HPD Budget updates Budget Codes & Certification Page.

Step 35: Amendment Required — Yes

Action On the right, the Action Item asks: “Amendment Required?” To demonstrate the amendment path, select Yes, add comments (for example, “Required for amendment”), and click Submit.

Result The PM requests an amendment.

Step 36: CP Original Completed — Amendment Tab Created

Action The CP - Original module is now Completed (Amendment Required = Yes, CP Stage Done). Guidance instructs you to navigate to the Amendments tab, which has been created. Click the Amendments tab.

Result The original CP is complete and an amendment record is spun up.

Step 37: Open the Amendment Record

Action On the Amendments tab, the Amendment Request related list shows CP - Amendment1 - Atlantic Housing Partners LLC (Status In Progress, CP Type Amendment, CP Stage Ready for Review). Click it to open.

Result The amendment module opens.

Step 38: Work the Amendment — Same Process

Action The CP - Amendment1 module opens and follows the same process as the original: as the PM, upload the required documents under the Documents tab.

Result The amendment is worked exactly like the original CP.

Step 39: Amendment Documents Submitted

Action On the Documents tab, the amendment documents are uploaded and show as Submitted.

Result The amendment package is ready to route through approvals.

Step 40: Approval Work Item — Full Amendment Chain

Action On the Approval Work Item tab you can review the full approval flow the amendment moves through — from the CP Management Team (Analyst Assignment) to the CP Analyst Review and CP Analyst Sign Off, then the Budget Details Review — and finally back to the Program PM.

Result The amendment has completed the review chain and returns to the PM.

Process map reference: Visio — amendment routes through the same review & sign-off chain.

Step 41: Review the Amended Budget — No Further Amendment

Action Back with the Program PM at the Budget Details Review stage, the Budget Details now show the change: the original budget ($150,000) plus the new amendment budget ($250,000) roll up to a Budget Total of $400,000. After review, on the Amendment Required? Action Item select No, add comments (for example, “No need of amendment”), and click Submit.

Result The amended budget is accepted and no further amendment is needed.

Step 42: Amendment Completed

Action The CP - Amendment1 module is now Completed (Amendment Required = No, CP Stage Done), with both budget records totaling $400,000.

Result The amendment is complete.

Step 43: The Original CP Shows the Completed Amendment

Action On the CP - Original module’s Amendments tab, the CP - Amendment1 record now shows Completed (CP Stage Done).

Result Both the original CP and its amendment are complete. Click Projects to return to the project.

Step 44: End of the Flow — All CP Modules Complete

Action On the project record’s Modules list you can see the full picture: Article XI (Completed), C&S Underwriting, CP - Original (Completed), and CP - Amendment1 (Completed).

Result This completes the Certificate to Proceed process, including the amendment.

Summary

You followed a Certificate to Proceed package from start to finish. A CP module is created either manually from the project (Initiate Process → Certificate to Proceed) or automatically from a completed Article XI module. The Program PM compiles the CP Package — Narrative Questionnaire, Underwriting Workbook, and Budget Code Questionnaire — and submits it. The Capital Budget Team (CP Management Team) verifies the documents and assigns a Capital Planning Analyst, who reviews the package, adds the Budget Details, uploads the Certification Page, updates the CP Package Submission Details, and submits to OMB. The Program PM reviews the budget; when an amendment is required, a CP Amendment is created and worked through the same review and sign-off chain. Once the amended budget is accepted, both the original CP and the amendment are marked Completed on the project.

Notes & Disclaimers

  • This guide follows the standard approved path; a rejection or a request for more information routes the package back for edits. Repetitive approvals are condensed and shown via the Approval Work Item tab.
  • Some steps (OMB / ROSE review and issuance of the date-stamped certificate) happen outside PIMS; PIMS records the key dates, documents, and approvals.
  • Screens, field names, and buttons may vary by role, permissions, browser, and future PIMS updates. Names, IDs, and data shown are from a training/sandbox environment.
